name: const unsafe fn as_mut_unchecked (& self) -> & mut T
rule: Calling `UnsafeCell::as_mut_unchecked` requires that no other references to the wrapped value are alive.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::cell::UnsafeCell < T > { const unsafe fn as_mut_unchecked (& self) -> & mut T }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: no available observation tracks other live references to the wrapped value.
